heading: Realtime codes
text:
## Realtime codes [NERR.18]

The codes realtime raises ([NRTM.1.1]). A code is realtime's exactly when this
clause defines it. This clause is deferred, so none of these binds this
edition. Each keeps its number in `libds.h`, and this table is the one place it
is defined ([STYL.2.13.4]).

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `DS_ERR_WM_FULL` | assert rejected: `N_max` reached under a realtime contract ([NRTM.3.1]) |
| `DS_ERR_TOKEN_BUDGET` | a join fan-out cap was exceeded |
| `DS_ERR_RT_UNSAFE` / `DS_ERR_RT_LIVE` / `DS_ERR_RT_PRECOND` | RT mode with a required bound unset; an operation forbidden in LIVE mode; a go-live pre-condition unmet |
| `DS_ERR_BND_RT_CONFIG_MISMATCH` | `rt_config_sha256` disagrees between artefacts |
| `DS_ERR_CONTRACT_MISSING` | a `realtime` DSC has no `RealtimeContract` atom |
| `DS_ERR_CONTRACT_INVALID` | the `RealtimeContract` atom is malformed or its hash mismatches |
| `DS_ERR_RTCT_PROFILE_REFUSES_DSRT` | a profile binary was asked to write `.dsrt` |
| `DS_ERR_CONTRACT_WCET_HALT` | a pump exceeded `pump_wcet_ns`; returned by that pump, which halts the tier ([RTCT.7.3]). Later calls return `DS_ERR_ENGINE_HALTED`, but the few [NCBK.2.9] leaves valid |
